paite: Huai thilte nung in, Tiberias tuipi ah anungzuite kiang ah Jesu akilak nawn a; hichibang in amah mah akilak hi.
heading: Tiberias Tuipi Ah Jesu Akilak
english: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

paite: Simon Peter leh Thomas, Didum achih uh, Galili gam a Kana a Nathanael, Zebedai tapa nihte, anungzui dang nihte toh a-omkhawm uhi.
english: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

paite: Simon Peter in akiang uah, "Ngasa man ding in ka kuan dek," achi a, amau akiang ah, "Kou leng na kiang ah ka hong sam ding uh," achi uhi. Apawtkhia ua, long ah atuang ua, huai zan in bangmah aman kei uhi.
english: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

paite: Phalvak in piautak ah Jesu ava dingh a; himahleh anungzuite'n Jesu ahi chih athei kei uhi.
english: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Naute aw, nek ding banghiam na nei uhia?" achi hi. Amau akiang ah, "Nei lou," chi in adawng uhi.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Long sik taklam ah len pai le uchin na man ding uh," achi hi. Apai ua, ngasa atam ziak in akaikhe zou kei uhi.
english: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

paite: Huchi in nungzui Jesu itpa'n Peter kiang ah, "Toupa ei ve," achi hi. Huchi in Toupa ahi chih Simon Peter in atheih in, apuanak tungsilh ateng a, amah vuaktang a om ahi a, tuipi ah atawmkheta hi.
english: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

paite: Himahleh nungzuite'n long neuchik in, len ngasa a dim toh kai kawm in ahon zuan ua, gam a kipan in agamla ngal kei ua, tong zanih hiam phet ahi.
english: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.

paite: Huan gam a ahong suahtak un, meihol a mei tohsa atung a ngasa leh tanghou emsa amu uhi.
english: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Tu in na ngasa mat uh akhen hon latou un," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

paite: Huchi in Simon Peter ava tuang a, ngasa lian pipi a dim tui gei ah ahon kaikhia a, zakhat sawmnga-le-thum apha hi; huchi lawmlawm in tam mahleh len akek kei hi.
english: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Zing an hong ne un," achi hi. Nungzuite lak ah kuamah in akiang ah, "Kua na hia?" chi in adong ngam kei uh. Toupa ahi chih athei uhi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

paite: Huan Jesu ahong pai a, tanghou ala a, akiang uah apia a, ngasate leng huchibang mah in ape sam hi.
english: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

paite: Huai tuh Jesu misi lak a kipan athohnawn nung a, anungzuite kiang a akilak thumveina ahi.
english: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.

paite: Huan zing an anek khit un, Simon Peter kiang ah Jesu'n, "Simon, Johan tapa, nang hiaite sang in kei na hon itzaw hia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Hi, Toupa, ka hon it chih na thei hi,” achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka belamnoute vak in," achi hi.
heading: Peter Kiang A Jesu Thu Nanungte
english: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

paite: Huan anihveina ding in akiang ah, "Simon, Johan tapa, nang kei na hon it hia?" achi nawn hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Hi, Toupa, ka hon it chih na thei hi,” achi nawn hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka belamte ching in," achi hi.
english: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

paite: Huan athumveina ding in akiang ah, "Simon, Johan tapa, nang kei na hon it hia?" achi hi. Huan thumveina a nang kei na hon it hia? chi a akiang a agen ziak in Peter alungkham a, akiang ah, "Toupa, bangkim na thei a, ka hon it chih na thei hi,” achi hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Ka belamte vak in."
english: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

paite: "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na naupan lai in na tai ah na kigak a, na utna peuh ah na hoh a; himahleh na upat hun chiang in na khut na zak ding a, midang in ahon gaksak ding ua, na utlouhna lam ah ahon kai ding uh," achi hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”

paite: Huai thu bangchidan a si in ahia Pathian apahtawi ding, chih theihsakna ding a agen ahi. Huai agen khit in akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi.
english: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”

paite: Huai khit in Peter akihei a, Jesu nungzui itpa, nitak an nek lai a a-awm ngai a hong awnphei a, "Amansak dingpa kua pen ahia?" chipa'n, amau hon zui amu hi.
heading: Jesu Leh Nungzui Dang
english: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”

paite: Peter in amah amuhtak in, Jesu kiang ah, "Toupa, hiai mi'n bang ahih dia?" achi hi.
english: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Ka hong pai nawn tan a om nilouh ding in deih leng, huai nang bang lunghimoh zenzen? Nang hon zui in," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”

paite: Huchi in huai nungzuipa si lou ding in athu unaute lak ah athangta a; himahleh Jesu'n asi kei ding chih akiang ah agen kei a, "K'ong pai nawn tan a om nilouh ding in deih leng, huai nang bang lunghimoh zenzen?" chi lel ahi zaw hi.
english: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”

paite: Huai nungzuipa, "Hiai thu theisakpa leh gelhpa ahi; huan athu theihsak adik chih i thei uhi."
english: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

paite: Huan hiaite lou leng Jesu thilhih dang tampi a-om lai a; huaite gelh vek ding hileh, laibu gelh ding tengteng khovel ah leng tazou in ka gingta kei hi. Amen.
heading: Thukhitna
english: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.
